changes.background: Mr. Rajiv Dube is an industry veteran with over 40 years of multi-sector experience at Tata and Aditya Birla conglomerates. He held roles including President of the car business at Tata Motors and executive director on the Aditya Birla group board.
changes.education: Engineer and post-graduate in Business Management

Executive Director on the group board of the Aditya Birla group

changes.background: Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession dealing with commercial property, infrastructure, project finance, dispute resolution, capital markets, and M&A. She has been associated with and a partner at Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners, and Jerome Merchant + Partners.
changes.education: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) and Bachelor of Arts with a major in Psychology; qualified solicitor
